description: Detect reusable feedback and check newly written lines against repository-owned rules.

hooks.command: input=$(cat); prompt=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"prompt"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); if printf '%s\n' "$prompt" | grep -Eiq '(from now on|next time|always |never |don.t |do not |instead|i told you|you should|remember to|stop )'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"This prompt may contain reusable feedback. Evaluate it with the lesson skill. Do not write any rule until the user approves the exact wording; skip one-off corrections and policies already covered."}}'; fi

hooks.statusMessage: Checking added lines against the rulebook…
